description: Source code for building and managing curriculum structures in a FreeCodeCamp project, including functions for creating superblocks, blocks, and curriculum validation.

classes.name: BlockInfo
classes.description: Interface representing information about a curriculum block.

methods.name: getBlockCreator
methods.description: Creates a BlockCreator instance configured for a specific language.

methods.name: getTranslationEntry
methods.description: Retrieves translation entries for a given English ID and text across all languages.

methods.name: createCommentMap
methods.description: Builds a map of English comments to their translations in all supported languages.

methods.name: addSuperblockStructure
methods.description: Constructs superblock structures from filenames, transforming raw data into structured objects.

methods.name: addBlockStructure
methods.description: Adds detailed block structure information to superblocks.

methods.name: getSuperblocks
methods.description: Returns a list of superblocks containing a specific block.

methods.name: validateBlocks
methods.description: Validates that all blocks referenced in superblocks have corresponding structure files.

methods.name: parseCurriculumStructure
methods.description: Parses and validates the curriculum structure, returning superblocks and certifications.

methods.name: buildCurriculum
methods.description: Builds the full curriculum data structure for a given language, including superblocks and certifications.
